title: Write operator installation and first-run guide
description:
Write docs/operator/installation.md: prerequisites (Rust toolchain, IPFS node), build from source, generate operator key pair, write minimal config files for transit and reader, start both daemons, verify with a test newsreader connection. Includes troubleshooting section for common startup failures. Artifact: docs/operator/installation.md.

Acceptance criteria: a new operator with Rust experience can get both daemons running from this doc; all commands are copy-pasteable; expected output shown for each step
